By Tachyon

Tachyon Stellar Private Settlement

SCF #46
$100.0K
Build
Submitted

Products & Services

Tachyon adds a Soroban settlement adapter and SDK for private cross-chain payments. Stellar is used as a destination first, with a defined asset corridor, encrypted recipient information, solver liquidity, duplicate-fulfilment protection and verifier checks. The integration supports selective disclosure for authorised institutions and auditors, monitoring, expiry, recovery and refunds. This gives Stellar-held assets a practical path to external liquidity while preserving privacy across the chain boundary.

Tranche 1 (Deliverable Roadmap) - MVP

- Soroban settlement adapter and SDK skeleton for the first Stellar destination route.

- Define the supported asset corridor, intent format, recipient encryption and solver settlement interface.

- Add unit tests and an integration test harness for the Stellar destination flow.

- Measure completion: public code in the Tachyon GitHub repository, documented interface, passing automated tests and a working test deployment.

- Budget: $20,000 for Soroban adapter engineering, SDK scaffolding and test infrastructure.

Tranche 2 (Deliverable Roadmap) - Testnet

- Complete the Soroban contracts and verifier integration for the Stellar destination route.

- Implement selective disclosure, authorised viewing, expiry, recovery/refund paths and duplicate-fulfilment protection.

- Publish the onchain monitoring plan and corresponding threat model required for the integration.

- Complete security hardening and audit readiness, including threat-model review, adversarial testing, monitoring and remediation of findings.

- Measure completion: deployed test contracts, documented monitoring and threat model, test evidence, and a security review package ready for the final review.

- Budget: $40,000 for security engineering, audit readiness, monitoring and remediation.

Tranche 3 (Deliverable Roadmap) - Mainnet

- Mainnet launch of the Stellar destination settlement route with the SDK and documented integration.

- Run a controlled production release with capped limits, solver liquidity, monitoring, recovery controls and selective disclosure for authorised institutions and auditors.

- Complete professional user testing, publish the integration documentation and provide transaction and usage evidence.

- Measure completion: mainnet contracts and SDK live, a successful end-to-end settlement, published documentation, user-testing report and post-launch monitoring.

- Budget: $40,000 for production deployment, final fixes, professional user testing and launch operations directly tied to the build.
